title: Cranberry-Pomegranate Relish
description:
Of all the Thanksgiving or Christmas leftovers that crowd the fridge, cranberry relish is the one I crave the most. We typically make it with oranges and apples and plenty of sugar. It’s great for a sandwich (on soft white bread) with cold turkey and mayo the next day – breakfast, lunch, whenever.
This one is a little different, just to try out something else from time to time (thanks to NYT’s Melissa Clark).
ingredients: ⅓ cup honey, or to taste
directions: Place cranberries and honey in a food processor. Pulse until chopped (but not too finely), then taste and stir in more honey if needed. At this point, the relish can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours before serving. If the liquid separates, give it a stir.
Stir pistachios and pomegranate seeds into cranberry mixture and serve.
